finding.title: Research Report — Loop-First Workflow & the 3-Tier Agent Stack
finding.hook: **Boris Cherny (creator of Claude Code): "I don't prompt Claude anymore. Loops prompt Claude for him."** The artifact is a single goal-spec prompt (GOAL / WHERE THE WORK IS / HOW TO WORK / HOW TO CHECK YOURSELF / HOW TO REMEMBER via `LOOP-STATE.md` / WHEN TO STOP) that runs one item at a time, proves done with evidence, and parks human-only decisions on a "needs me" list. ([Raytar, 1.26M impressions, 1,390 bookmarks](https://x.com/Raytar/status/2069212188619805179))
